recent_reports.title: The Lifespan Fund: Reforming the State Pension for a More Affordable, Flexible and Fair FuturePaper | 1st May 2026A modern safety net should provide more support during working life while offering more flexibility over how and when support is drawn in later life.
recent_reports.summary: We propose replacing the state pension with the Lifespan Fund. recent_reports.title: Tech & DigitalisationTechnological Chokepoints: How to Balance Resilience and Leverage in a Weaponised EconomyPaper | 22nd April 2026Middle powers need a strategy to navigate technological interdependence: build resilience where it counts and use leverage wisely to stay competitive.
recent_reports.summary: It is not possible for leaders to opt out of the technological revolution. Innovation, scientific advancements and the development and diffusion of frontier technologies are the fundamental building blocks of prosperity and power. Yet, as well as a source of growth, technology is also an arena for competition and conflict.
key_recommendations: There is therefore a paradox: being part of this interdependent technological economy is necessary for competitiveness, security and building state capacity but, for precisely that reason, it is also an unequivocal source of vulnerability that must be grappled with.

To do this, leaders will be required to balance three competing priorities: Resilience: Individual countries must ensure that their economy, government and security are resilient in the face of potential disruption when trying to access key frontier technologies, regardless of the cause.
